source_distributions: IMD 0.25-deg daily gridded rainfall, grid 11.50N 79.50E, 1901-2024 (seasonal + year-conditioned + storm templates)
Copernicus GLO-30 DEM regional terrain + Neyveli mine-engineering bench layer
Neyveli lithological/material classes with measured geotechnical ranges (total/undrained)
NIRM 2005 attenuation model: PPV = 858.90*(D/sqrt(W))^(-1.58), freq 5-27 Hz
Crack-state model (tension/desiccation/blast/seepage/heave) with severity decision surface
notes: Every record in the CSVs is tagged synthetic:true. See docs/03_DATA_PLAN.md, docs/04_MODEL_PLAN.md, docs/05_FEATURE_SCHEMA.md, docs/GENERATOR_V1_SPEC.md. Constants frozen in data/processed/{geotech,blasting,cracks}/*.csv.
